facts.fact: ZimStat's spokesperson said the existing Census and Statistics Act is regarded as outdated and does not adequately support an effective national statistical system or big-data and administrative-data sharing; the Act is in force (no date of the Act given, so the article's published date is used).

note: Reach not recorded: the article says the 2025 MICS7 survey will be conducted under the Act's authority, which is a survey carried out, not a dated act of the law applied.

facts.fact: This document is the consolidated text of the Census and Statistics Act [Chapter 10:29] (Act 1 of 2007), which establishes the Zimbabwe National Statistics Agency and commenced on 1 July 2009.

note: The 2020 Amendment Act (Act 4 of 2020) is an amendment to the law, not a rule made under it; no reach fact.

facts.fact: ZIMSTAT states that official statistics in Zimbabwe are carried out on the basis of the Census and Statistics Act from 2007, which sets up the Zimbabwe National Statistics Agency and its Board (no event date given, so the page's published date is used).

note: Page also says the Act is not fully in line with international practice and the African Charter on Statistics is unsigned; both class other, no fact.
The charter sets out the ZIMSTAT Board's governance and refers only to 'national legislation' without naming the statistics law or tying the act to it, so no standing or reach fact is recorded.
News on a household listing exercise for the 2026/27 Household Budget Survey; it says only that the survey is run under the Census and Statistics Act, with no dated act, standing or rule.
Document states nothing on a statistics law.

facts.fact: ZIMSTAT's acting director-general said the October 2026 listing exercise is conducted in terms of the Census and Statistics Act, which mandates ZIMSTAT to collect official statistics.

note: SPI 5.1.1 is a compliance score with no named law; states no fact.

facts.fact: A SADC Secretariat notice of 22 April 2025 tenders a consultancy to review Zimbabwe's current Statistics Act and draft a revised one.
